in_arabic.name: جُبران
in_arabic.meaning: شخصي عِزٌّ، بُردَةُ النَسَبِ، بَهاءُ المَنزِلَةِ
in_arabic.long_meaning: جُبران من اصل الجـبر، يَدُلُّ على عِزٍّ وَبُردَةَ النَسَبِ، وَمَنزِلَةٍ بَاهِيَةٍ، وَيكونُ هذا الاسمُ مشتقاً من الجَبَرَ، فهو يَدُلُّ على تَقَدُّمِ الإنسانِ، وَمِن هَذا المنزِلَةِ يَكونُ المُؤمِنُ بِأَنّا لِلَّهِ وَأَنّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، وَيُذكَرُ أيضاً في القرآن الكريمِ في سورة الحجر، آية 47.

in_urdu.name: جبراں
in_urdu.meaning: شخصی عزت، نیک خصلت، عظیم شخصیت
in_urdu.long_meaning: جبران کا مطلب عزت اور نیک خصلت ہے جبکہ یہ نام جبر سے مشتق ہے جس کا مطلب انسان کو آپنے آپ پر فخر اور عزت ہے، ایک مسلمان کے لئے یہ نام بہت اہم ہے کیونکہ یہ نام ایمان کا اظہار کرتا ہے اور ایمان کا مطلب ہے کہ ہم خدا کے سامنے اپنے اعمال پر جوابدہ ہوں گے اور وہیں ہمیں اس کے سامنے جائیں گے، یہ نام ایک اہم اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلمانوں میں پسند کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_english.name: Jubraan
in_english.meaning: Personal dignity, nobility, exalted character, a name that signifies high moral character, nobility of birth, and high social status
in_english.long_meaning: Jubraan is a name that signifies high moral character, nobility of birth, and high social status. Derived from the Arabic root jubur, which means 'to be exalted' or 'to be elevated', this name is associated with the concept of personal dignity and nobility. In Islamic tradition, this name is considered a reflection of one's character and moral fibre, and is often given to children to instill in them a sense of pride and self-respect. The name Jubraan is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Hijr, verse 47, and is considered a name of great significance in Islamic culture.

data.cultural_impact: The name Jubraan carries a rich cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is a name that was given to a powerful and benevolent character in Islamic history, Jubrail - Prophet Ibrahim's (Abraham) servant. As a servant of Ibrahim, Jubrail holds a special place in Islamic tradition. He is known for his unwavering loyalty, devotion, and generosity towards his master. The name Jubraan therefore represents the qualities of strength, grace, and generosity. It also carries the significance of a dedicated servant of God, reflecting the Islamic value of serving Allah and his creation.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jubraan holds great spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It is mentioned in the Quran and is associated with the servant of Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), Jubrail. Jubrail is described as a noble and powerful figure who served his master with unwavering devotion and obedience. The name Jubraan thus represents the qualities of grace, generosity, and power that come from being close to Allah. It is a reminder of the importance of serving Allah and being a generous and benevolent servant to others.
